name: Long Message User
message: Hello, I am interested in your Full Stack Development course and I wanted to know several details before I decide whether I should enroll. I have been learning programming for some time and I have basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, and SQL, but I have never worked professionally as a software developer. I am currently trying to improve my skills and prepare myself for a full-time software engineering job. I would like to know whether your Full Stack Development course is suitable for someone at my current level and whether I need to complete any prerequisite courses before joining. The main thing I want to understand is the complete course structure. I would like to know which technologies and frameworks are covered, whether the course starts from frontend fundamentals and then moves toward backend development, and whether students get practical experience by building complete projects. I am particularly interested in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, REST APIs, databases, authentication, Git, deployment, and cloud technologies. If there are any additional technologies included in the course, I would also like to know about those. I also want to know how the classes are conducted. Are the classes live or recorded? How many classes are held every week, how long is each class, and what is the usual class schedule? I work during the daytime, so evening or weekend classes would be more convenient for me. Please let me know when the next batch starts, how long the complete course takes, and whether students can access recorded classes if they miss a live session. Another important issue for me is the course fee. Please tell me the total fee for the Full Stack Development course and whether there is an installment payment option. If installment payments are available, I would like to know how many installments are possible and when each payment needs to be made. I would also like to know whether there are any registration fees or additional charges for certificates, projects, examinations, or other services. If there are currently any discounts or special offers, please provide the official details rather than assumptions. I am also interested in knowing how much practical work is included. I don't want to complete a course that only contains theoretical lectures. I would prefer a program where I can build real-world applications and create projects that I can demonstrate during job interviews. Please explain whether students receive assignments, coding exercises, project reviews, code reviews, or mentor feedback. I would also like to know whether students work individually or in teams for the final project. Career support is another thing I want to understand. After completing the course, does your organization provide career guidance, CV preparation, interview preparation, mock interviews, portfolio guidance, or job search assistance? I am especially interested in understanding what kind of support is available for students who want to become junior or entry-level full stack developers. I understand that completing a course does not automatically guarantee employment, so I would like to know exactly what career services are actually included. I would also like to know whether the course provides access to instructors or mentors outside normal class hours. For example, if I face an issue while working on an assignment or project, can I ask questions through a support group or discussion platform? How quickly do instructors normally respond? Is there a dedicated community where current students and previous students can communicate with each other and share technical knowledge? Please also explain the admission process. Do I need to take an assessment or interview before enrolling? Is there any age requirement or educational qualification? If someone has learned programming independently without having a computer science degree, can they join the course? I have a non-CS academic background, so this information would be useful for me. I would also appreciate information about the certificate. Is a certificate provided after successful completion of the course? What are the requirements for receiving it? Do students need to attend a certain percentage of classes or complete specific assignments and projects before receiving the certificate? Finally, I would like to know whether there is a trial class, orientation session, or any way to understand the teaching style before making the payment. I want to make sure that the course content, schedule, teaching method, practical projects, mentoring, and overall structure match my learning goals. Please provide the official information about the course fee, installment options, next batch date, class schedule, course duration, technologies covered, project work, mentoring, and career support so that I can make an informed decision about enrollment. Thank you for taking the time to read my long message and provide the details.
